sources.label: Wikipedia, "Sigma Octantis"
sources.quote: Sigma Octantis is a solitary star in the Octans constellation that forms the pole star of the Southern Hemisphere.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 4.3 solar radii and 2.26 solar masses (FLAME) and 7,192 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Sigma Octantis"
sources.quote: Its name is also written as σ Octantis, abbreviated as Sigma Oct or σ Oct, and it is officially named Polaris Australis.
